narrative.text: Gregor Marić delivers Soraya's reply in person. He places a single sheet of paper on your desk — written in the careful, determined penmanship of a woman who learned to write in night classes after twelve-hour factory shifts.

Soraya said to read this to you myself. She said: 'Tell the Chancellor I received her letter. I have been waiting for someone in that building to apologize for anything — anything at all — for thirty years. Hers is the first apology I have received. I do not trust her yet. But I will trust her enough to wait. The general strike is postponed. Do not make me regret this.'

choices.text: "Tell Soraya I will not make her regret it. The next budget will remember the workers. I am writing that promise in my own hand — and this time, I intend to keep it."
